Strong to severe thunderstorms are also possible behind this wall of
dust. Keep updated with this quickly evolving situation.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 9 at 9:46PM CDT until August 10 at 12:45AM CDT by NWS Huntsville AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Madison County in north central Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 1245 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 942 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges measured 2
to 3" of rainfall in about half an hour earlier this evening,
with rainfall totals between 3-4" estimated in portions of
Northern and Western Huntsville. Local creeks in the city rose
several feet in an hour as a result. Indian Creek at Madison also
rose 4 feet during this time, and it continues to slowly rise.
Indian Creek should crest between 7 and 8 feet around or after
midnight, and slowly fall through sunrise.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntsville, Madison, Redstone Arsenal, Triana, Marshall Space
Flight Center, University Of Alabama In Huntsville, Huntsville
International Airport and Alabama A And M University.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
